deepseek.notes: Primary candidate for bounded implementation, Java/Python build-test-debug loops, qualification and CI remediation. Use explicit fresh/resumed sessions; no silent quota fallback.

muse.notes: Long campaigns, large-context continuation, difficult sustained debugging and cross-model review.

glm.notes: Scarce frontier lane for nonlocal root cause, cross-subsystem semantic defects and difficult fresh-context review.

space-bunny.notes: Bulk/repetitive/mechanical execution and GitHub /oc lane; critical semantics require normal evidence gates and preferably cross-model review.

activation_gate.blocker: Active ownership overlaps launcher/governance surfaces on 2026-09-28; do not co-edit.
required_validation: exact four-profile allowlist and one highest native variant per model
explicit profile selection and child --model pin
no automatic fallback on quota/auth/catalog/tool/child failure
telemetry/context/state provenance for selected profile/model/native variant
